main_text.l: סָגַד Procumbere honoris exhibendi causâ, Adorare. Chald. Praeter. שְׁגַד Adoravit procumbendo. Part. סְגָדִין לִצְלֶם Procumbebant coram statua, Dan. 3. 7. Futur. וַיִּסְגֹּד Et adorabit, Dan 3.6: נִסְגַּד Adorabimus: תִּסְגְּדוּן Adorabitis.
סִגְנִים סִגַּן m.p. Antistites. Chal. סִגְנִיָּא, סִגְנִין

סָגַר Clausit, Conclusit, Occlusit: Tradidit, Dedidit. Sic Chal. וּסְגַר פֻּם Et occlusit os, Dan.6.22. Niphal נִסְגַּר Includi, Occludi, Includere se. Pihel סִגַּר Tradere, Dedere. Pyhal סֻגַּר Claudi, Occludi. Hiphil הִסְגִּיר Clausit: Dedidit.
סְגַר מִסְגָּר m. Carcer, Clauftrum: Clauftrarius.
מִסְגֶּרֶת f. Claufura, Fascia, Tænia: plurale, מִסְגְּרוֹת.
סָדִין סדן m. Sindon: plur. סְדִינִים.
סֵדֶר סדר m. Ordo: plur. סְדָרִים.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are reconstructed from a faint scan and may be inaccurate in places; the consonants are the more reliable reading. The catchword and running head are given as printed.
